name: Corin's Crossing
summary: The Scourge has overrun Corin's Crossing, where ruined streets mark an old meeting place in south-central Eastern Plaguelands. Once travelers passed through on their way between Stratholme, Tyr's Hand, Darrowshire, and Andorhal. Now horrors haunt the town hall and forge, and unseen watchers drift among the ruins.

sections.title: A Shattered Crossroads
sections.body: Before the Third War, Corin's Crossing joined the roads of eastern Lordaeron. Merchants, couriers, and pilgrims stopped at this waystation between Stratholme and the southern strongholds. The settlement stood between Lake Mereldar and the place now blighted as the Infectis Scar. When the plague swept through the province, the undead vanguard reached the town. Corin's Crossing soon fell beneath its assault.

sections.title: A Haven of the Damned
sections.body: The Scourge holds Corin's Crossing now, and wandering undead crowd its muddy streets. Rotting hulks and ghouls linger in the hollowed blacksmith shop and town hall. Scouts face another danger among the ruins. Unseen Servants drift beyond ordinary sight, pierce mundane stealth, and ambush anyone trying to slip past the main horde undetected.

faq.q: What was Corin's Crossing before the plague?
faq.answer: Before the plague, Corin's Crossing was a prosperous hub in eastern Lordaeron. Its town hall and blacksmith forge stood at the heart of a waystation between Stratholme, Tyr's Hand, Darrowshire, and Andorhal. The Scourge wiped out its people.

faq.q: Why is Corin's Crossing so hazardous for stealthy travelers?
faq.answer: Unseen Servants haunt Corin's Crossing as invisible phantoms bound to the Scourge. They pierce magical and mundane stealth, then surprise unwary rogues or scouts and alert nearby undead.

faq.q: What major landmarks surround the town?
faq.answer: Corin's Crossing stands in south-central Eastern Plaguelands. The blighted trench of the Infectis Scar lies nearby, and Lake Mereldar runs along the town's border.
The Scourge holds Corin's Crossing. No living defenders remain, and wandering undead soldiers and spirits swarm the settlement.

angles.text: Do not trust your shadows here. Unseen Servants roam the alleys, unseen by mortal eyes, and see through your stealth. A walk through the town square can be fatal.
As a paladin, you see Lordaeron's heartland desecrated at Corin's Crossing. The ruins remain a wretched Scourge stronghold, mocking Stratholme's holy bastion further up the road.
